property_summary: For any successful payable call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether when block.timestamp strictly increases, the reference contract always updates pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp (so pastBlockTime == block.timestamp), whereas the mutant that assigns pastBlockTime = block.number will cause pastBlockTime != block.timestamp for some fuzzed block timestamps/numbers.
change_summary: Update pastBlockTime using block.number instead of block.timestamp so stored value differs and future timestamp comparisons would behave differently.
